query: DO $$ DECLARE v_template_id UUID; v_section_e_id UUID; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_template_id FROM public.inspection_templates WHERE code = 'government-hospital-accreditation'; IF v_template_id IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE public.inspection_template_sections SET section_label = 'SECTION B — ADMINISTRATION, PERSONNEL & DRUG MANAGEMENT', sort_order = 2 WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'B'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET section_code = 'B' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'DRUGS'; DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_sections WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'DRUGS'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_sections SET section_label = 'SECTION C — PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION', sort_order = 3 WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'IMPLEMENTATION'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_sections SET section_label = 'SECTION D — FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT', sort_order = 4 WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'FINANCIAL'; SELECT id INTO v_section_e_id FROM public.inspection_template_sections WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'CHALLENGES'; IF v_section_e_id IS NULL THEN INSERT INTO public.inspection_template_sections (template_id, section_code, section_label, description, sort_order) VALUES (v_template_id, 'CHALLENGES', 'SECTION E — CHALLENGES AND RECOMMENDATIONS', 'Facility feedback, risks, and recommendations', 5) RETURNING id INTO v_section_e_id; ELSE UPDATE public.inspection_template_sections SET section_label = 'SECTION E — CHALLENGES AND RECOMMENDATIONS', sort_order = 5 WHERE id = v_section_e_id; END IF; DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_items WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'OBS'; DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_items WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'CHALLENGES'; INSERT INTO public.inspection_template_items (template_id, section_code, item_code, item_label, response_type, max_points, sort_order) VALUES (v_template_id, 'CHALLENGES', 'Q029', 'What are the challenges facing ORANGHIS in your facility?', 'text', 0, 1), (v_template_id, 'CHALLENGES', 'Q030', 'What are your recommendations?', 'text', 0, 2), (v_template_id, 'CHALLENGES', 'Q031', 'Apart from these questions, are there other information you would like to share with the ODCHC concerning the operations of ORANGHIS in your facility?', 'text', 0, 3), (v_template_id, 'CHALLENGES', 'OBS', 'Please provide details of your observations here', 'text', 0, 4); UPDATE public.inspection_template_sections SET section_label = 'SECTION F — INTERVIEWER DETAILS', sort_order = 6 WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'REMARKS'; DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_items WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'REMARKS'; END IF; END $$;
